status: selection and hypotheses before implementation/model outcomes

priorities.hypothesis: Most of the F61 elapsed-time increase occurs outside recorded active tool spans; new request/body-consumption spans can bound it without calling it provider inference or pure network time.
priorities.comparison: Historical F61 interval reconstruction plus identical passive timing observer in all new arms.
priorities.measure: Union/intersection of timestamped tool and fetch-to-headers/first-read/end spans, unmatched/pending/cancelled/error spans and observer limitations.
priorities.risk: Observer changes backpressure or conflates overlapping phases; test content/cancellation/no-eager-read invariants.

priorities.hypothesis: Length-relative boundary cases and reused-state checks detect contract regressions missed by authored tests.
priorities.comparison: Archived F60 suffix defects against archived authored tests, and common strengthened finite oracle against pristine/positive/negative controls.
priorities.measure: Exact test discovery, executed/pass/fail counts, defect detection and independent oracle outcomes; do not rescore historical campaigns.
priorities.risk: Overstrict oracle, vacuous test passes or inferred public obligations; derive expected behavior from explicit task contracts and retain positive controls.

priorities.hypothesis: An edit receipt that explicitly marks historical invocations as ineligible for current source reduces unsupported final-check claims.
priorities.comparison: Current Light baseline, only provenance feedback changed, integrated Cline; all other mechanisms common and existing admission/required checks unchanged.
priorities.measure: Exposure, following exact reruns, strict audited success, accurate final-source reporting, tokens/cache/SDK cost/time with every assigned failure retained.
priorities.risk: Payload/latency overhead, confusing source-current with environment/completeness/acceptance or hidden historical results.
